Evan (Sales): ACME POC blocked. They pinned rwd-7b-v2-quant@2026-02-01 to eu-west-2 and get: HTTP 503 {"error":"model_unavailable_in_region","model":"rwd-7b-v2-quant","region":"eu-west-2"}. Need quick fix for POC and answers for their security questionnaire.

Priya (Solutions): Paste error — also they want to know if Dedicated can be provisioned in Azure EU for PII.

Evan (Sales): Pasted above. Contract requires immutable pin for the POC. They already submitted SSQ.

Lena (Eng): Root cause: quant artifact wasn't replicated to eu-west-2 (we removed it during a housekeeping pass). Control plane will 503 when strict pin requested. We typically fallback to a compat artifact if pin strict=false.

Sam (Infra): We hit an Azure storage quota during the last sync — replication queued, estimate ~4h. Can do expedited copy if given permission and we accept transfer cost.

Priya (Solutions): Short-term options: 1) remove strict pin (fast) 2) switch to fp16 variant in region (fast) 3) we copy artifact to eu-west-2 and create a signed alias (satisfies immutability) (~2h). Which is acceptable?

Evan (Sales): Customer insists on pinned immutable artifact. They'll not remove pin. Also asking about artifact provenance and KMS.

Raj (AE): For SSQ: we can confirm artifacts are SHA256-signed, KMS supported for Dedicated/Private, audit logs available. Need eng to confirm alias semantics.

Lena (Eng): Confirm SHA256-signed on publish. Alias copy approach: copy blob, replicate signature metadata, create short-lived alias bound to same checksum. Control-plane can accept alias for a token subset.

Priya (Solutions): If we create alias and sign it, the customer gets an immutable-looking pin. Include note in SSQ: alias cryptographically bound and logged.

Sam (Infra): I can run the expedited copy and validation. Estimate 2h to copy + checksum validate + write alias metadata. I'll also add a runbook.

Evan (Sales): They'll test if we can do it within the day. What about cost?

Raj (AE): Recommend we absorb one-time staging cost for this POC to close the deal; escalate to GTM for approval post-facto.

sec-qa-bot: New SSQ received: https://acme.example/ssq/2026-03-21/ACME-POC

deploy-bot: task create-artifact-alias started by Sam at 1854322400
deploy-bot: [INFO] copying rwd-7b-v2-quant blob -> eu-west-2
deploy-bot: [INFO] validating checksum sha256:ab12...ef34
deploy-bot: [OK] alias created in 130m

Sam (Infra): Alias created and verified, runbook added: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/replicate-artifact-eu. Ready to flip alias for ACME token.

Lena (Eng): Verified signatures and checksums. Control-plane change scoped to ACME token only. I'll approve the flip.

Priya (Solutions): SSQ draft updated with artifact alias details and fallback policy. Sending to ACME once alias live.

Evan (Sales): ACME will test pinned alias token and report back. Thanks team. :tada:

Raj (AE): Marking POC as green on absorbing cost. Filing follow-up ticket to prevent future region artifact deletions.

Evan (Sales): Closing loop. If they see perf variance vs local benchmarks we'll reopen this thread.
